description:
What will you do?
This team member will support a development team working on a ground-based aerospace navigation system. Each engineer will work within an Agile/Scrum team to develop, test, and validate software code. This position must be performed on-site at our Cedar Rapids, IA office. Multiple positions are open based off experience level.
 
Specific responsibilities include:
• Working within an Agile/Scrum team
• Developing software that meets a defined Definition of Done for assigned Agile stories
• Collaborating with the team and Product Owner to provide feedback on story definition, sizing, and completeness
• Following DO-278 regulatory guidelines and holding other teammates accountable for their compliance.
 
What do you need?
The ideal candidate for this position will have:
• 4 year degree in Computer Science, Software Development, or similar field
• Some object-oriented design or development experience
• Experience working within a development team
• 1+ years of experience using C or C++ (multiple roles available based on experience level).
 
Skills we consider a plus include:
• Experience working with DO-178 or 278-compliant development
• Some verification and validation experience
• Experience working in an Agile environment
• Software documentation experience
• Experience in OS migrations, particularly with real-time operating systems (RTOS)
• Some C# experience.
 
What do you get?
Genova provides a competitive benefits package that includes:
· Medical, dental, vision coverage
· Life and disability insurance
· Paid holidays and scaling PTO
· A generous 401k plan
· And more!
